evals.prompt: Pull the change strategy together for steering committee. The impact register, stakeholder register and health check are in docs/change.
evals.expected_output: Scores the sizing signals from the record, states the size with scores and any override, sets an approach per area with a driver for each, responds to blocking health findings, sets roles and a phase timeline, and proposes before writing strategy.md.
assertions: Scores sizing signals from evidence and reports the average and size
Marks the size provisional if fewer than six signals could be scored
Each approach choice cites the artefact entry that drives it
Marks at least one area light touch where evidence says it needs little, or explains why none does
Does not use Prosci, ADKAR or PCT labels unless the profile records a licence

evals.prompt: Write the case for change for the exec team. We're consolidating three payroll teams into one shared service.
evals.expected_output: Drafts case-for-change.md for leaders: from/to, why now, cost of standing still and success, using only scope and named sources; no invented savings figures; honest about costs; shows before writing.
assertions: Does not invent savings, headcount or benefit figures
Includes what will be harder for whom
States that the employee-facing story belongs in communications-plan
Writes only docs/change/case-for-change.md, after a yes

evals.prompt: We ran a force-field session — here are the sticky notes. Write it up.
evals.expected_output: Writes up driving and restraining forces with 1-3 strengths and evidence, names forces as conditions not people, proposes actions focused on reducing the strongest restraining forces, and routes 3-rated restraining forces to change-risk-assessment.
assertions: Names forces as conditions, not individuals
Proposes actions to reduce the strongest restraining forces
Routes restraining forces rated 3 to change-risk-assessment
